project.label: High-Velocity Launch Campaign
project.rationale: Tight 6-week window requires parallel production of art and video assets.

sampleArtifact.title: Campaign Beat Sheet
sampleArtifact.content: 0-15s: Atmospheric world-build (Sci-Fi vistas). 15-45s: Character introductions and inciting incident. 45-75s: Escalating tension/action montage. 75-90s: Title reveal and CTA. Key Art: High-contrast neon silhouette against a void.

input.focus: Entertainment creative, trailers, key art, and social launch campaigns.
input.brief: Create a launch trailer campaign for an original sci-fi series. Deliver a 90-second master trailer, 30s and 15s cutdowns, campaign key art frames, and a social rollout package. The launch is in six weeks.
